sut.name: TrainTicket
sut.deploy: k8s/minikube via make deploy (with OTel->Jaeger tracing)

injection.trigger_input: valid route: >=2 existing stations, startStation and endStation both in stationList, names 2-50 chars

ground_truth.label: positive
ground_truth.rationale: With the flag on, createAndModifyRoute returns status:1 'create and modify success' but skips the persist POST to ts-route-service, so the route is never saved. The acknowledgement is a lie; the write is lost. Verified by read-back: GET getAllRoutes does not list the route.

provenance.notes: Headline case: the write is silently dropped, so there is NO downstream 5xx and NO response marker; every status/schema/body and trace-shape oracle passes it clean. Only the read-back differential catches it. Traces + read-back to be captured at Gate 1 per prep/gate1-environment-runbook.md.
